outcome: Variation in charges and discounted prices for vaginal and caesarean deliveries
cohort: 76,766 patients with uncomplicated vaginal deliveries and 32,660 with uncomplicated caesarean sections in California in 2011
finding: Significant variation in charges and discounted prices for uncomplicated vaginal and caesarean deliveries exists between hospitals in California, with factors such as hospital competition, wage indices, casemix, and profit status explaining some of this variation.
